```yaml
name: Publish Studio NPM

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'studio-v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to publish (e.g., 1.0.0)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  publish-studio:
    name: Publish @decocms/studio to npm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/studio

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Build Studio Package
        run: bun run build

      - name: Determine Version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          else
            # Extract version from tag studio-v1.0.0 -> 1.0.0
            VERSION=$(echo "${{ github.ref_name }}" | sed 's/^studio-v//')
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Publishing version: $VERSION"

      - name: Set Package Version
        run: |
          # Update package.json version to match the tag/input
          # Use a temporary file to avoid injection issues with json -e
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(bunx json -f package.json -e "this.version")
          NEW_VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          echo "Updating version from $CURRENT_VERSION to $NEW_VERSION"
          bunx json -I -f package.json -e "this.version = '$NEW_VERSION'"

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
